svg.title: OpenE2EE product lockup — dark
svg.desc: The horizontal OpenE2EE lockup with the product name on a second line, flush with the left edge of the symbol.
svg.metadata: Lockup: product; mode: dark; symbol height 128; wordmark cap height 71.19; generated by @open-e2ee/design 0.21.2. Set in Public Sans; the wordmark is live text and needs the family available.

text.font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
